decisions.reason: The two-component glass flake spraying system extends the firm's core spraying know-how into corrosion-protection niches; its prospects are still uncertain one year after launch, and keeping it listed costs little, so the option is worth holding.

The low-pressure injection pump sits close to the established construction-repair offer and has its own web page, so carrying costs are low and there is no evidence its value has failed to materialize.
This multi-model transfer pump line builds on core conveying competence with near-complete in-house manufacturing, so keeping it is cheap and its value is still unfolding.
Fire protection flow monitoring supports the firm's digitalization goals and has a dedicated page, and while its value is more uncertain, the option remains open at modest cost.
